description: Evidence and source graph for the Thriving Neighborhoods pillar. Entities and relationships are drawn from the deep-research corpus in research/, and every one of them traces to a cited sentence in a specific report and on to the primary source that sentence cites. The evidence log, source inventory and post-event research add the pain points, populations, jobs to be done and open questions behind each proposed project. This corpus contains no financial dataset, so there is no funding layer.
